text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...! My head's been
pounding since this morning!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Guess I got no choice, I'll keep the headband on for a while...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Why? Because a headband is the best cure for a headache, right?
There's even a phrase for it: 'headache headband.'

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Tightenin' somethin' around my temples eases the headache, see.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: What's that look for? Don't tell me ya don't trust me?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: "If I recall, wasn't it something like... the headband compresses the blood vessels in your head to ease the pain...?"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Thinking about all that complicated stuff
made the pain flare right back up...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, though I recommended headache medicine to Inari One instead of a headband, she was plagued by a headache for a while.
